title: Independent linearized nonthermal Pauli χe collision eigenmodes and physically conservative finite-volume time integration
objective: Compute the linearized full Pauli 2->2 χe kinetic operator around FD for independent nonthermal perturbations at fixed N, including correct tail/interpolation and discrete conservation; compare its eigenmodes to conditional γ_T,moment. Then build an actual quantum positivity/number/energy-preserving finite-volume evolution coupled to a finite SM bath. Do not confuse fixed-N thermal energy-moment rate with true kinetic thermalization or replace the old phenomenological BGK.
prerequisites: Check PR #1 HEAD; verify GitHub Actions #44936484677 for e10b683 and repair failures
Read kinetic codes relativistic_nonlinear_fermion.py, conservative_energy_projection.py, thermal_energy_relaxation.py, lepton_portal_chirality.py, full-Pauli 5D quadrature reference
detailed_plan: Pre-register physically relevant perturbations δfχ(p)=FD(1−FD) h(E), including constrained zero-number modes, thermal-temperature mode and oscillatory/IR/hard-tail distortions. Derive linearized collision J around common Te, from exact F−R and independently from analytic entropy dissipation.
Build an exact-FD-preserving logit-energy basis that captures arbitrary small perturbations without PCHIP false equilibrium signal; quantify finite qmax and interpolation error.

Compute small kinetic response matrix for a finite basis of h(p), with actual 5D Pauli collision integrals and independent angular/q convergence. Verify electron detailed balance, number-conserving null mode, nonpositive entropy quadratic form, stable complex spectra within estimated quadrature error.

Project conditional temperature variation at fixed N onto J and check whether energy moment matches γ_T,moment≈3.03183e−7 GeV in the electron-only benchmark; document why this need not equal slowest eigenvalue.

Construct a finite-volume event-pair transfer discretization with nonnegative deposition and correct capacity/Pauli bounds. Distinguish the moment projector from a valid timestep. Prove number and energy/SM Q transfer and track entropy under explicit or implicit quantum-compatible integrator.

Validate dynamic step under dt, qmin,qmax,p/k/angle refinement and external BEST density conventions. Never rethermalize χ by free resetting. Add SM gstar and heat dynamical equation once physically justified.
Check channel completion: G_L=G_R pure-vector e implies ν_L channel; at T above EW symmetry, need a full mediator and thermal masses. Do not extrapolate 6/4 ratio into general cosmological epochs.

Record measured positive AND negative results in compact JSON, append evidence, checkpoint and commit/push fast-forward, continue automatically to next independent scientific bottleneck in same active execution.
acceptance: Independent finite-dimensional linearized collision basis convergence and N fixed point at common T, explicit entropy quadratic form
Measured comparison of slow modes and FD thermal-energy moment with honest errors and no false gamma_el identification
Actual Pauli-bounded time step in physically weighted radial energy bins, with Qχ+QSM=0 and no hidden heat reservoir
Class_ready false and 86eV DM/BEC/Ω freezeout unproven until separate full cosmological/observational validation
fallback: Start with two independent nonthermal perturbation modes and exact-FD logit interpolation, then enlarge basis only when strong/weak and cutoff errors controlled
If full conservative network is too costly, prove an analytically closed limited collision subspace and explicitly tag approximations
If CI fails or branch concurrent update, repair/reconcile first, preserve checkpoint and no force pushes
deliverables: tests and numerical results for linearized kernel
quantum conservative finite-volume time integrator and tests
scope: Public research branch/draft PR only. No merge or force-push, no user's computer without separate approval.
